title: Israeli strike in Sanaa targets Houthi government ministers
body:
On 28 August 2025 the Israeli Air Force carried out targeted strikes, codenamed Operation Lucky Drop, in the Bayt Baws area of Sanaa, Yemen. The targets were Houthi government ministers who had gathered to watch a televised speech by Houthi leader Abdul-Malik al-Houthi, including defence minister Mohamed al-Atifi, chief of staff Muhammad Abd al-Karim al-Ghamari and prime minister Ahmed al-Rahawi.

The Wikipedia article's infobox says at least 13 officials were killed, while its text says later reporting confirmed 12 deaths, including the prime minister, nine other ministers and two cabinet members, citing the Long War Journal. The Houthis confirmed al-Ghamari's death on 16 October, and Israeli Defense Minister Israel Katz said he died of wounds. Al-Atifi was reported on 29 August to have survived with serious injuries.

The Israel Defense Forces confirmed the strike and later said it had targeted the defence minister and chief of staff. Katz compared it to the Biblical plagues of Egypt and warned that anyone who raised a hand against Israel would have it severed. A Houthi defence source first denied that senior leaders were targeted and said the attacks hit civilians. The group later called the strikes criminal and treacherous. Supreme Political Council leader Mahdi al-Mashat vowed revenge, and Abdul-Malik al-Houthi vowed to escalate missile and drone attacks on Israel.
